description: A fictional cartoon science-fiction toy lightning gadget, a chunky toy-like game prop (not a real object, no working parts). A boxy off-white body with rounded corners, longer than it is tall. On its front face a round riveted mid grey flange and a stepped grey neck, from which a straight mid grey rod points forward, wrapped in a wide spiral of four turns of thick bright copper orange wire, and ending in a large mid grey ball. On top of the body two upright clear glass tubes with rounded tops and small grey tip caps, each filled flat bright purple, standing in round mid grey base sockets, in a row one behind the other on the centre line. On the left flank of the body a big round mid grey riveted gauge rim with a flat bright yellow face and a small grey needle. Underneath at the rear a dark brown handle raked backward, with a bright red curved finger lever inside a rounded mid grey loop in front of the handle. At the rear of the left flank, near the top, a mid grey round pivot carrying a flat grey lever arm that stands upright above the body and ends in a bright red ball. A bright yellow round cap is on the right flank of the body.
proportions: About 0.50 m long, 0.16 m wide and 0.30 m tall. (length : width : height = 3.13 : 1 : 1.88)
sides: the big round gauge with the yellow face and the pivot of the upright lever with the red ball are on the left flank only; the bright yellow round cap is on the right flank only; everything else is symmetric left to right.
